math_argument.shift_zero: Returns original int64 unchanged, including INT64_MIN.
math_argument.shifts_1_to_63: Magnitude <=2^63 and bias <=2^62, so magnitude+bias <=3*2^62 <2^64. Rounded quotient <=2^62 and signed conversion/negation are representable.
math_argument.shift_64: Only INT64_MIN has magnitude 2^63, exactly one half of 2^64; ties-away returns -1. Every other int64 magnitude is below half and returns zero.
math_argument.shifts_above_64: Every int64 magnitude is strictly below half; return zero without attempting an out-of-width machine shift.
math_argument.asr: Existing floor shift is safe: at shifts1..62 unsigned magnitude+divisor-1 stays below2^64; at >=63 signed result is zero or minus one.
